author: Blizzard Entertainment
description:
Using over 1,600 artifacts spread across a massive 35‑foot table, we wanted to tell a story about where we’ve been — and offer a nod toward where we’re going. 

To honor 35 years of Blizzard, our Archives, Brand & Creative, and Events teams brought this project to life using real, physical mementos of the worlds we've built together. 

This isn’t just a look back — it’s a look forward. The next chapter has already begun. Read our blog to learn more: https://news.blizzard.com/article/24250386
